template.name: initializer
verticalCar
template.parameter: int id, int length, int x, int y

transition.label: s : int[1, n]
canMove(id, x, y, 0, -1, length, false, s)
move_car(id, x, y, 0, -1, length, false, s), y -= s, total_moves += 1
s : int[1, n]
canMove(id, x, y, 0, 1, length, false, s)
move_car(id, x, y, 0, 1, length, false, s), y += s, total_moves += 1

template.name: horizontalCar
template.parameter: int id, int length, int x, int y

transition.label: s : int[1, n]
canMove(id, x, y, -1, 0, length, true, s)
move_car(id, x, y, -1, 0, length, true, s), x -= s, total_moves += 1, movec += (id == 1 ? 1 : 0)
s : int[1, n]
canMove(id, x, y, 1, 0, length, true, s)
move_car(id, x, y, 1, 0, length, true, s), x += s, total_moves += 1, movec += (id == 1 ? 1 : 0)
